text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy has received a present<n>from one of
her fans.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
WAAAHAHAHA! These fans of mine<n>sure are
thoughtful!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
This really is a huge box, though. I<n>wonder what's
inside...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Time to tear it open and find out!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Boooiiinnng!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Grraaagh?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: A j-j-jack-in-the-box?! They wanted<n>to scare me!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Grrr! What's this smart-aleck tryna<n>prove, eh?
choice_data_list: ...There's also a letter in the box.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huh? I didn't notice. Give it here!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"After reading one of your interviews<n>in a
magazine, I learned that you love<n>pranks, Windy."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"So I decided to put together a<n>surprise present for
you!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Sorry for the jump scare! But feel<n>free to use the
idea for your own<n>mischievous deeds! From, Your
biggest fan"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Grawr! I'm the one who scarespeople! Not the other way around!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Grrr! But I guess it was a pretty<n>decent prank!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
The fan must've put a bunch of<n>thought into it for
my sake...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmph! I guess I'll forgive 'em just<n>this once!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Now I know it's easy to fool<n>someone by posing as
their fan and<n>giving 'em a present!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'mma keep this letter and<n>jack-in-the-box as
mementos!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Hehehe. I should've expected a fan<n>of mine to
have a sense for these<n>things!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although she suffered quite a fright,<n>Shinko Windy
seems rather pleased<n>with the present from her
fan.
